scripts.verify:app: npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run db:reset && npm run db:lint && npm run db:advisors && npm run test:db && npm run build && wrangler deploy --env beta --dry-run
scripts.db:lint: supabase db lint --local --schema app_private,api --level warning --fail-on warning
scripts.db:advisors: supabase db advisors --local --type all --level warn --fail-on warn
scripts.db:types: supabase gen types typescript --local --schema api,app_private > src/types/database.generated.ts
scripts.deploy:beta: npm run verify:app && wrangler deploy --env beta
scripts.deploy:beta:dry-run: npm run verify:app && wrangler deploy --env beta --dry-run
